in_sanskrit.name: नियति
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who is fixed or established in their nature, actions, or decisions. A name for a child who is believed to have a strong and determined character.

in_hindi.name: नियती
in_hindi.long_meaning: Niyat (नियत) means fixed, established, determined, decided in Hindi. Niyati (नियती) is the feminine form of this word.

in_tamil.name: நியதி
in_tamil.long_meaning: Niyati (நியதி) is derived from the Tamil word 'niyam' which means rule, regulation, or custom. Another meaning for Niyati is 'niřkum' which means established, fixed, or settled.

in_telugu.name: నిಯతి
in_telugu.long_meaning: Niyati (నియతి) is derived from the Telugu words 'niyat' (నియత) which means fixed, established, determined, or decided. Another meaning for Niyati is 'dēśiy' (దేశియ) which means one who has control or authority, or 'pōyēśa' (పోయేశ) which means ruler or king.

in_marathi.name: Niyati
in_marathi.long_meaning: Niyati हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Niyati is a Sanskrit name that comes from the root word 'Ni' which means direction or decision. In Hindu mythology, Niyati is considered the goddess of justice and righteousness. She is the embodiment of fairness and impartiality, ensuring that every soul is treated justly in life and in death.
